params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of objects that can be retrieved.

params.name: id
params.description: Version ID of a version of a document contained in a matter

params.name: type
params.description: An attachment is not part of a matter's version history, but is typically used to store supporting documentation. A new 'version' is a new document saved as a new version, while a 'draft' version is an updated copy of the previous 'version' type group version.

params.name: state
params.description: Current State of the matter version

params.name: assigned_to
params.description: User ID of the user a matter is assigned to

params.name: assigned_at
params.description: Date and time the matter version was last assigned to a user

params.name: name
params.description: Information about the matter hidden in the user interface
